event_var.var_meaning: death from any cause (1 = death event; 0 = censored/alive)

notes: Variables appear in GEO sample metadata (e.g. GSM2528079 includes 'overall survival days' and 'overall survival event').
Paper methods (SCAN-B) define overall survival as death from any cause; event coding 1=death, 0=alive/censored is inferred from metadata and the paper definitions.
No recurrence/relapse (RFI) variable is present in the GSE96058 GSM fields (RFI is reported for Cohort270 in the papers but not in these sample metadata).
